claims.text: US vaccines: Vi capsular polysaccharide (ViCPS, Typhim Vi) IM; live attenuated Ty21a (Vivotif) oral.
claims.quote: Vi capsular polysaccharide vaccine (ViCPS) (Typhim Vi, manufactured by Sanofi Pasteur) for intramuscular use; and live attenuated vaccine (Vivotif, manufactured from the Ty21a strain of serotype Typhi by PaxVax) for oral use

claims.text: ViCPS: age ≥2 y; dose q2 yrs if still @ risk.
claims.quote: The vaccine is approved for use in people ≥2 years old. A dose is recommended every 2 years for those who remain at risk

claims.text: Live oral vax: age ≥6 y; booster q5 yrs if still @ risk.
claims.quote: The vaccine is approved for use in people ≥6 years old. A booster is recommended every 5 years for those who remain at risk
